description: A six-operator FM synthesizer with classic-style voices and one-key chords.

controls.action: Play the key's chord in E minor (KEY mode).
Build any chord: type buttons plus extensions.
Next of the twelve FM voices.
Edit the four parameters on the current page.
Return that parameter to its default.
Next voice.
Next page: PLAY, TEMPO, KEY, VOICE, EFFECT.
HOLD: keep the chord sounding after the key is released.
Choose that voice.
Show that page.
Change it.
Start audio if it stopped.
Chord type for the next key; MAJ+MIN is aug, MAJ+SUS is sus2.
Add extensions; they stack (MIN7+9TH is a 9th).
Latch it on until tapped again; CLEAR drops all latches.
With no buttons, KEY on plays the key's diatonic chords; off plays single notes.

controls.control: CHORD / STRUM / SLOP / ARP / HARP · Tap
controls.action: How the chord is played; ARP and HARP follow BPM and DIVISION, STRUM and SLOP follow STRUM RATE.
Tap the beat a few times to set BPM.
VOICING (inversions), BASS (root voice level), PLAY MODE, BPM.
BPM (40–240), DIVISION (1/4 to 1/32, triplets), SWING, STRUM RATE.
KEY root, SCALE (major or minor), OCTAVE, VELOCITY.
ALGORITHM (1–32), FEEDBACK, BRIGHT (modulator levels), DECAY (carrier rates).
CHORUS, DELAY, REVERB, VOLUME.

sections.title: Sound
sections.text: Six sine operators per voice routed by one of 32 algorithms, each with ratio, detune, output level and a four-rate, four-level envelope; one operator feeds back on itself. Sixteen voices; the bass is a separate voice an octave below the chord.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: The voice, page, tempo, play and key settings, effects and voice edits save automatically.
